task.description: REWORK 1: Re-run the ADP-04a test specification against the updated coverage mapping. Confirm the revised spec now explicitly includes TC-ADP-04a-06 and that the integration suite/report reflects automated coverage for NULL-linkage coexistence, duplicate non-NULL realm/sub rejection, and index/backfill proof. Produce an updated structured test report under tests/reports/. Do not modify implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: Updated spec coverage for TC-ADP-04a-06 is recognized
All ADP-04a cases are either executed or explicitly mapped to existing automated tests
Test report clearly marks pass/fail for each case
Any remaining gaps include reproducible details and affected artifacts

result.summary: Re-ran the ADP-04a integration suite against the real PostgreSQL test database and updated the structured report, but TC-ADP-04a-06 still lacks dedicated automated coverage for NULL-linkage coexistence, duplicate non-NULL rejection, and index/backfill proof.

issues.description: TC-ADP-04a-06 is still not covered by a dedicated automated test in tests/integration/adp04a_external_identity_linkage_test.zig. The current suite proves internal NULL linkage behavior, OIDC provisioning, and tenant-collision handling, but it does not explicitly exercise multiple internal NULL-linkage rows coexisting, duplicate non-NULL realm/sub rejection, or index/backfill proof as required by the revised spec.

result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGNER for explicit TC-ADP-04a-06 coverage
